verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26729453 from Guangzhou PackRight to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318704 (dated 2026-07-27). One line: 17,500 pcs of PR-RB-2207 Collector's Box Grand Heist 6 at 25.62 CNY each, confirmed for 2026-09-30. Terms are FOB Yantian, NET30. A note says the lid magnets RM-N42-D0401 (4 per box) are fitted by the supplier and included in the unit price.
red_flags: The note says the magnets RM-N42-D0401 are fitted in the supplier's plant and included in the unit price. Check this against the buyer's own sourcing or supply of magnets, to avoid double-buying or a price mismatch.
observations: Single-page printed PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The document has no issue date of its own. Only the PO date (2026-07-27) is shown.
The unit of measure for the quantity is not stated.
The Chinese heading reads 订单确认书 (order confirmation).
